verdict.rationale: The docs include many copy-pasteable code examples across Python, TypeScript and Rust (quickstart search, multi-vector search, table deletes and column transforms), so examples exist. There is no evidence of an interactive API explorer or in-browser runnable playground, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. missing for 10: interactive API reference/explorer, in-browser runnable examples, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of doc quality.
